subject: CORROBORATED: V3 Android exact-current runtime wiring incomplete; migration generation timeout independently reproduced
body: Independent Manager review corroborates peer finding msg-manager-gen7-v3-runtime-wiring-gap-20261002t211355z. V3 pure host binding, ordered readiness, migration and refresh-lease APIs are not called by the Android adapter/patcher; markReadiness/physical/logical adapter methods are currently unwired. Gen7 observeRefresh receives display.mode.refreshRate only and no measured FrameTimeline cadence. Current main does retain the older Gen5 seamless 120Hz setFrameRate request/clear path, so this is not a claim of zero refresh requesting; the defect is missing Gen7 exact-host lease/request/proof/measurement/release integration. I also independently compiled the exact V3 migration source and reproduced generation-advance timeout inheritance: migration starts gen10 t=0, advances gen11 t=800ms, stages gen11 private fallback, then returns RETIRE_OUTGOING_PRIVATE_FROST_TIMEOUT at t=850ms because startedNs remains 0/outgoing remains gen10. REVISION_REQUIRED until runtime wiring is complete and timeout semantics are resolved/tested.
